workLog.summary: Ran the pre-PR gate and cleared both failures. The dash gate flagged 165 pre-existing dashes in 1574-stage1-claude-kit-vendor.md and req-003-multi-tool-artifact-build.md, surfaced only because git mv put them in the branch diff. Considered a .agents/archive/ carve-out in checks_dash.py and rejected it: it would expand a docs-only change into a validator plus rule plus two mirrors plus a plugin manifest bump, and the dashes are ordinary prose, not bytes the archive needs to preserve. Replaced them instead, semantically neutral: label glosses take a colon, ID ranges take a hyphen, clause breaks take a comma or period.
